capabilities.summary: Sage syntax compiles to JavaScript and runs on Node.js.
capabilities.implementation: Python- and Sage-aware compiler, generated runtime, and ordinary CPython-parseable mathematical library modules.
capabilities.evidence: Compiler corpus, tutorial corpus, CLI, and upstream doctest suites in CI.
capabilities.target: Expand source compatibility while preserving distinct Python and Sage modes.

capabilities.summary: Standalone sagejs and sagepython executables run without a separate Node installation.
capabilities.implementation: Node single-executable applications for Linux x64/arm64, Windows x64, and macOS arm64.
capabilities.evidence: Relocation and smoke tests run on every supported platform in CI.
capabilities.target: Signed, reproducible releases on every desktop platform.

capabilities.summary: Install and use Sage.js as a Jupyter kernel from the CLI or native executable.
capabilities.implementation: Jupyter wire protocol, kernelspec installer, rich display, graphics, and completion.
capabilities.evidence: Host and SEA wire-protocol tests plus kernelspec regression tests.
capabilities.target: Polished installation and rich-display behavior in JupyterLab, CoCalc, and other frontends.

capabilities.summary: The compiler runs in the browser; native mathematics coverage through WASM is incomplete.
capabilities.implementation: Browser compiler plus a FLINT WebAssembly package and explicit native/WASM boundaries.
capabilities.evidence: Dedicated WebAssembly build and smoke tests.
capabilities.target: Expose the complete native mathematical surface through WASM with capability-tested fallbacks.

capabilities.summary: A SageCell-style evaluation service is designed but not yet a security boundary.
capabilities.implementation: Roadmap proposes isolated workers, memory-backed storage, limits, streaming output, and defense in depth.
capabilities.evidence: Threat-model and implementation roadmap in .agents/safe-sage-eval-roadmap.md.
capabilities.target: A documented, adversarially tested service API with platform isolation beneath the language restrictions.

capabilities.summary: Exact arbitrary-precision integer and rational arithmetic with Sage-compatible parents and elements.
capabilities.implementation: FLINT-backed native arithmetic with JavaScript runtime integration.
capabilities.evidence: Focused unit tests, native-addon tests, compiler corpus, and upstream Sage examples.
capabilities.target: Continue broadening Sage API compatibility and performance coverage.

capabilities.summary: Prime and extension finite fields support arithmetic, coercion, roots, and standard constructions.
capabilities.implementation: FLINT-backed finite-field elements with Sage-style factories and polynomial integration.
capabilities.evidence: Finite-field regression suite and imported Sage doctests.
capabilities.target: Broader extension-field algorithms and representation compatibility.

capabilities.summary: Exact univariate and multivariate polynomial arithmetic over common coefficient rings.
capabilities.implementation: Native FLINT kernels plus Sage-compatible rings, coercion, factorization, roots, and ideals.
capabilities.evidence: Polynomial, ideal, approximate-polynomial, and upstream compatibility suites.
capabilities.target: Deepen algorithms over general coefficient domains and quotient structures.

capabilities.summary: Polynomial ideals provide useful Gröbner basis and reduction functionality; large research workloads need stronger engines.
capabilities.implementation: Readable Sage.js algorithms with native polynomial foundations.
capabilities.evidence: Polynomial-ideal regression tests and book examples.
capabilities.target: Integrate or port msolve-class algorithms, then add syzygies and free resolutions.

capabilities.summary: Matrices, vectors, kernels, echelon forms, normal forms, characteristic polynomials, and exact solving.
capabilities.implementation: Sage-compatible matrix spaces backed by native exact arithmetic.
capabilities.evidence: Matrix-focused corpus coverage, native tests, and downstream number-theory tests.
capabilities.target: Add more structured and sparse algorithms without weakening exact semantics.

capabilities.summary: Numerical eigenvalue and related spectral computations are available for real and complex matrices.
capabilities.implementation: Numerical backend integrated through Sage matrix APIs.
capabilities.evidence: Dedicated spectral-linear-algebra regression suite.
capabilities.target: More decompositions, precision control, and performance benchmarks.

capabilities.summary: QuadraticField and quadratic NumberField presentations compute rings of integers, ideals, class numbers, and class groups.
capabilities.implementation: Exact binary quadratic forms and ideal lattices, including discriminant and presentation normalization.
capabilities.evidence: Exhaustive and randomized comparisons with Sage/PARI plus focused NumberField regression tests.
capabilities.target: Faster certified class-group computation over larger discriminants.

capabilities.summary: General number fields support exact element arithmetic, embeddings, discriminants, and foundational order operations.
capabilities.implementation: Readable field, order, and lattice code over exact polynomial and matrix foundations.
capabilities.evidence: Number-field and algebraic-number regression suites with Sage/PARI comparisons.
capabilities.target: A complete, scalable, certified algebraic-number-theory stack.

capabilities.summary: Maximal-order construction works for a foundational range of number fields, with exact lattice transformations.
capabilities.implementation: p-maximal enlargement and exact integral-basis bookkeeping.
capabilities.evidence: Known difficult examples and randomized comparisons against Sage/PARI.
capabilities.target: Complete local algorithms, proofs/certificates, and competitive high-degree performance.

capabilities.summary: Exact ideal lattices support construction, arithmetic, norms, membership, inversion, and principality foundations.
capabilities.implementation: Canonical integer-module representations with explicit basis changes among field, order, and ideal coordinates.
capabilities.evidence: Invariant tests and cross-checks against established computer algebra systems.
capabilities.target: Prime decomposition, valuations, residue fields, ideal classes, and scalable reduction.

capabilities.summary: Beyond quadratic fields, complete class groups and unit groups remain a major gap.
capabilities.implementation: The required order and ideal-lattice substrate is being built first.
capabilities.evidence: Tracked as a foundational research milestone, with PARI, Magma, Hecke, and Oscar as comparison systems.
capabilities.target: Certified relation collection, analytic bounds, saturation, units, and proof modes.

capabilities.summary: Low-degree polynomials have exact Galois-group classification; general degree is not implemented.
capabilities.implementation: Discriminant, resolvent, factorization-pattern, and explicit permutation-group logic.
capabilities.evidence: Low-degree exhaustive comparisons against Sage/PARI and representative Magma checks.
capabilities.target: General resolvent and Stauduhar-style algorithms with certified identification.

capabilities.summary: Primality tests, integer factorization, prime enumeration, and efficient prime counting are available.
capabilities.implementation: Native arithmetic plus combinatorial prime-counting algorithms.
capabilities.evidence: Arithmetic tests and complete pcimc book demonstrations including prime_pi(10^12).
capabilities.target: Broader certificates, algorithm selection, and large-input benchmarks.

capabilities.summary: Core p-adic fields, rings, precision semantics, and arithmetic work; Sage's full p-adic ecosystem does not.
capabilities.implementation: Exact precision-aware p-adic elements and parent structures.
capabilities.evidence: Dedicated p-adic test suite and dependent elliptic-curve local computations.
capabilities.target: Extensions, more precision models, transcendental functions, and local-field algorithms.

capabilities.summary: Dirichlet groups, characters, conductors, values, Bernoulli data, and key L-value computations are available.
capabilities.implementation: Exact finite abelian-group arithmetic combined with numerical and symbolic evaluation.
capabilities.evidence: Dedicated Dirichlet regression suite and Sage-compatible book examples.
capabilities.target: More analytic continuation, functional equations, and precision-aware L-functions.

capabilities.summary: Curves and points over rational and finite fields support fast arithmetic, orders, pairings, and standard invariants.
capabilities.implementation: Projective formulas, exact coercions, fast scalar multiplication, and native finite-field kernels.
capabilities.evidence: Focused regression tests plus randomized Sage/PARI comparisons.
capabilities.target: Research-scale point counting, descent, Mordell–Weil, and heights.

capabilities.feature: Tate's algorithm and conductors over Q
capabilities.summary: Complete local reduction data includes difficult 2- and 3-adic cases and derives global conductors.
capabilities.implementation: Readable integral-model transformations and local case analysis with minimal-model tracking.
capabilities.evidence: Exhaustive local cross-checks against Sage/PARI and representative Magma data.
capabilities.target: Extend local data to number fields and add richer reduction certificates.

capabilities.summary: Kernel-polynomial construction and Vélu-style isogenies cover important rational and finite-field cases.
capabilities.implementation: Exact morphism data integrated with curve and point arithmetic.
capabilities.evidence: Composition, kernel, codomain, and cross-system regression tests.
capabilities.target: Isogeny graphs, modular-polynomial methods, duals, and high-performance finite-field workflows.

capabilities.summary: Modular-symbol spaces, Hecke operators, cuspidal subspaces, decompositions, and elliptic-curve links are available.
capabilities.implementation: Exact Manin-symbol and linear-algebra algorithms.
capabilities.evidence: Dedicated modular-symbol tests and broad comparisons with Sage.
capabilities.target: Higher weight, characters, richer decomposition, and performance at large level.

capabilities.summary: Common modular-form spaces and q-expansion workflows exist, but Sage's full modular-forms stack is much larger.
capabilities.implementation: Exact series, dimensions, bases, and connections to modular symbols.
capabilities.evidence: Modular regression suite and computational-number-theory corpus examples.
capabilities.target: Characters, newforms, eigenforms, coefficient fields, and scalable Hecke algebra computations.

capabilities.summary: Expression construction, simplification, differentiation, substitution, solving, limits, and integration cover useful cases.
capabilities.implementation: Native Sage.js symbolic tree and calculus algorithms rather than a remote CAS dependency.
capabilities.evidence: Dedicated symbolic tests and the now-complete pcimc book corpus.
capabilities.target: Systematic special functions, assumptions, transforms, branch analysis, and harder definite integrals.

capabilities.summary: Adaptive quadrature provides values and error estimates for finite and infinite intervals.
capabilities.implementation: Adaptive integration backend exposed through Sage-compatible numerical_integral APIs.
capabilities.evidence: Endpoint, singularity, tolerance, and book-example regression tests.
capabilities.target: Oscillatory methods, arbitrary precision, and multidimensional integration.

capabilities.summary: A practical NumPy-compatible array layer supports common numerical and educational workloads.
capabilities.implementation: Python-facing ndarray APIs over JavaScript typed arrays and numerical kernels.
capabilities.evidence: Dedicated NumPy compatibility suite.
capabilities.target: More ufuncs, broadcasting edge cases, dtype semantics, and optimized linear algebra.

capabilities.summary: Functions, points, lines, implicit curves, regions, and composed graphics render through Plotly.
capabilities.implementation: Sage-style graphics primitives and rich Jupyter HTML output.
capabilities.evidence: Graphics and export regression suites plus upstream book plots.
capabilities.target: More primitives, publication export, adaptive sampling, and fine-grained style compatibility.

capabilities.summary: Surfaces, parametric objects, polyhedra, scenes, transforms, and aspect ratios render interactively.
capabilities.implementation: Plotly 3D traces with Sage-compatible scene composition and self-contained Jupyter output.
capabilities.evidence: 3D regression suite covering geometry, serialization, transforms, and layout.
capabilities.target: Higher-performance meshes, textures, lighting, and broader Sage rendering semantics.

capabilities.summary: Python's sqlite3 programming model is available in Node environments with the built-in SQLite engine.
capabilities.implementation: Compatibility layer over node:sqlite with connections, cursors, parameters, transactions, and row factories.
capabilities.evidence: Focused sqlite3 regression suite including persistence and transaction semantics.
capabilities.target: Close remaining DB-API edge cases and expose an explicit browser capability fallback.

capabilities.summary: A broad practical slice includes files, OS, time, subprocesses, networking, arrays, randomness, serialization, and multiprocessing.
capabilities.implementation: Purpose-built Python-compatible modules over Node platform APIs.
capabilities.evidence: Module-specific integration suites on Linux, Windows, and macOS.
capabilities.target: Prioritize scientific and educational modules while keeping unsupported boundaries explicit.

capabilities.summary: A tree-sitter-based frontend translates a useful subset of Magma syntax into the Sage.js runtime.
capabilities.implementation: Language adapter within the shared polyglot compiler architecture.
capabilities.evidence: Parser, translation, and runtime regression tests.
capabilities.target: Expand grammar semantics using permitted examples and differential tests.

capabilities.summary: Basic Macaulay2 arithmetic, assignment, lists, calls, ranges, booleans, and comments compile and run.
capabilities.implementation: Adapter using the open tree-sitter-macaulay2 grammar.
capabilities.evidence: Focused foreign-language and polyglot tests.
capabilities.target: Rings, ideals, matrices, packages, and computational commutative-algebra semantics.

capabilities.summary: Proof-of-concept parsers demonstrate that other mathematical languages fit the architecture.
capabilities.implementation: Tree-sitter frontends targeting shared Sage.js runtime objects.
capabilities.evidence: Language-specific parser and smoke tests.
capabilities.target: Choose scope from real research and teaching use cases, then deepen semantics language by language.

capabilities.summary: Sage.js is installable from npm or with a curl-to-shell native installer.
capabilities.implementation: Meta-package plus platform packages for npm, and checksum-verifying release installer for native archives.
capabilities.evidence: Package, relocation, and installer tests in release CI.
capabilities.target: Publish the current 0.2 series with uniform signed artifacts and automatic update guidance.

capabilities.summary: CI has signing and notarization workflows, but production credentials and final cross-platform verification are still being completed.
capabilities.implementation: Apple Developer ID/notarization, Windows Authenticode, checksums, protected environments, and CI release gates.
capabilities.evidence: Release workflow fails closed when signing is required and validates produced artifacts.
capabilities.target: Every public desktop artifact signed and verified automatically from protected CI environments.

capabilities.summary: SageMath, PARI/GP, Magma, Oscar, Hecke, and Nemo provide independent comparison points.
capabilities.implementation: Differential test scripts, imported doctests, and benchmark fixtures rather than runtime dependencies.
capabilities.evidence: Cross-system checks are cited in focused mathematical test suites.
capabilities.target: A reproducible public benchmark and differential-testing dashboard.

capabilities.summary: Performance is tested locally, but historical results are not yet published systematically.
capabilities.implementation: Planned representative workloads, fixed reference hardware, and regression thresholds.
capabilities.evidence: Current benchmark notes and external reference installations establish the initial corpus.
capabilities.target: Browsable Sage.js versus Sage/PARI/Magma/Oscar results with commit-level trends.
